enroll.cmdCd: folder with the package and enrollment file
enroll.cmdQuarantine: unsigned build: clear the download quarantine
enroll.title: Pre-register a Connector
enroll.intro: Get a package and a one-time enrollment file for a computer, VM, NAS or router. Once installed and started it joins this account automatically—no pairing code needed.
enroll.name: Connector name
enroll.doneIntro: Follow these steps. The Connector shows up in the list above a few seconds after it starts. The enrollment file works once and expires {time}.
enroll.step2Hint: Contains this Connector’s one-time credential—don’t share it. It can’t be downloaded again after you leave or refresh this page; you’d need to pre-register again.
enroll.step3: Install and start it on that machine
enroll.step3Hint: Put both files in the same folder and run in a terminal:
enroll.linuxNote: Installs a systemd service that starts at boot (needs systemd and root).
enroll.foregroundNote: Runs in the foreground—keep the terminal open. Start it later with serve --platform --config-dir "$HOME/.openplayx-connector".
enroll.step4Hint: Once connected, open that machine’s Connector manager at http://<machine IP>:9080 (the first sign-in credential is the bootstrap-token file in its config folder) and add Jellyfin, SMB and other services.
enroll.pendingIntro: Not yet claimed by a Connector. Each one uses a Connector slot until it expires; cancel any time.
enroll.notDownloadedTitle: The enrollment file hasn’t been downloaded
enroll.notDownloadedText: After closing it can’t be downloaded again. The pre-registration stays until it expires; cancel it in the list and pre-register again.
enroll.revokeText: Any downloaded enrollment file stops working and the Connector slot is freed.

connectors.intro: Pre-register or bind your own Connectors. Services are configured on each machine.
connectors.emptyHint: Choose “Pre-register Connector” to get a package and an enrollment file that connect automatically once started—or create a pairing code in the Connector manager and confirm it here.
connectors.footer: Node choice, local service addresses, ports and adding or removing services are all configured in the Connector manager.

unbind.title: Unbind "{name}"?
unbind.text: Its services are removed from the platform and devices on this account lose remote access to them.
unbind.note: This doesn’t uninstall the Connector or delete local services or files. Bind it again to reconnect.
